lambda_summary.conservative_interpretation: Use the source fit lambda as the SDC mass exponent. Do not use the additional rough factor of two from M_KK ~ exp(-2 lambda Theta).

metadata.scope_note: The source supplies an asymptotic large-volume slope. This audit supplies Delta_moduli=1 as a benchmark; the source does not claim that generic string_tree_eft must occupy this point.
